# CcySI — Currency × Superintelligence

> Independent conceptual identity for intelligent currency orchestration, held by Sohadot. From currency intelligence to financial action.

CcySI proposes eight analytical functions: Observe, Interpret, Allocate, Authorize, Commit, Execute, Settle, Verify. Authorization and verification are cross-cutting. CCY means currency; SI denotes Standing Instruction in banking and Superintelligence as the chosen prospective identity. These are distinct meanings of SI; CcySI is not an operational financial service, standard, or claim of existing superintelligence.
